exam_scheme.note: Telangana State Law Common Entrance Test (TG LAWCET) is conducted as a Computer Based Test (CBT) by Osmania University on behalf of the Telangana Council of Higher Education (TGCHE) for admission into 3-Year and 5-Year Integrated LL.B. regular law degree programmes in universities and affiliated law colleges across Telangana. The examination consists of 120 multiple-choice questions carrying 120 marks with a duration of 90 minutes. The paper comprises three parts: Part A General Knowledge and Mental Ability (30 questions, 30 marks), Part B Current Affairs (30 questions, 30 marks), and Part C Aptitude for the Study of Law (60 questions, 60 marks, including 10 questions evaluating legal comprehension passages). Each question carries 1 mark with no negative marking. The qualifying mark is 35% (42 marks out of 120) for General and OBC candidates; no minimum qualifying mark is prescribed for SC and ST candidates.
